title: Let It Happen
author: Sankha Ranjan Patra
text:
Let this world collapse
Rocks may remain,
Cries may congregate ,
Quake may arise,
To blow up and to grow up again,
Let another Ocean originate .
Let this world collapse
Endless sorrow here,
Must have ended,
Broken into pieces,
Must have spread in space again,
Let another vacancy originate.
Useless all without you
Earth, Heaven and Life ,
I care none ,I desire none
Cheer, luxury , future ,
Maybe you may come back again
As a comet, who knows?
stanzas: To blow up and to grow up again,
Must have spread in space again,
Maybe you may come back again
